mellin_projection_definition.quote: Step 104: H=L^2(R), or the even subspace; P_lambda is the spatial cutoff projection onto [-lambda,lambda]; Phat_lambda=F^{-1}P_lambda F; S_lambda=ker P_lambda cap ker Phat_lambda; S_lambda is the orthogonal projection onto S_lambda. Step 102: P_infty is the archimedean Sonin/prolate projection. Step 162: P_infty is archimedean/Sonin projection in the Burnol/Sonine pulled-evaluator Hilbert context. Step 153/154 use its Mellin-side representative mathsf P_infty in (I-mathsf P_infty)M_{m_l}mathsf P_infty.
mellin_projection_definition.projects_onto: U_infty of the archimedean Sonin/prolate subspace, modeled in Step 104 as S_lambda=ker P_lambda cap ker Phat_lambda in H=L^2(R) or the even subspace.
mellin_projection_definition.measure_weight: Raw archimedean model uses L^2(R) Lebesgue measure in log/Fourier variable; Step 153 uses the Mellin boundary s=1/2+i tau. No inherited Step 153/154/162 record supplies an explicit integral kernel K_infty(s,s') or a projection onto a zeta-zero spectral region.

explicit_A_infty_formula: On the zero-free-output subclass G in G_Omega with supp(mathsf P_infty M_zeta G) subset Omega and ||1/zeta||_{L^infty(Omega)}<infty, A_infty^Omega G := M_{1/zeta} mathsf P_infty M_zeta G.
target_equivalence_proof_sketch: Full ZI-COV(i) implies that every projected zeta multiple mathsf P_infty M_zeta G is zeta-divisible, hence its zero-evaluator jets vanish at zeta zeros. This is a zeta-ideal invariance property of the inherited Sonin/prolate projection. It implies absence of zeros only under an additional jet-surjectivity assumption saying that the projected range can realize nonzero jets at each zero. No inherited definition of P_infty supplies such a spectral range or jet-surjectivity. Conversely, if the output support avoids zeros so 1/zeta is bounded, ZI-COV(i) holds on that subclass by explicit division. Thus the inherited records give not_target_equivalent, plus a zero-free-output subclass theorem.

strategic_lanes.goal: Construct a nonzero legal Burnol generator G whose projected zeta multiple has support in a fixed zero-free Omega.
Prove or refute whether mathsf P_infty M_zeta legal profiles can realize nonzero jets at zeta zeros.
Derive or import an exact kernel K_infty(s,s') for the Sonin/prolate Mellin projection and test zeta-ideal invariance.
Extend the zero-free-output proof from ZI-COV(i) to T_a mathsf P_infty M_zeta H = M_zeta A_{T,a}H.
